period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' tiled alongside Consolidated statements (legal name at the time was BRAC Bank Limited). The filing's own notes state 'Business of Off-shore Banking Unit (OBU) have been reported with solo Financial Statements.' Income-statement items use the 'Cumulative Jan to Sept 2016' column; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended July to Sept 2016' column (interest income 4,403,796,512; PAT 950,087,250; EPS 1.34) not recorded here. Matches the basis of this bank's own 2012-2016 Q4/annual series (solo). Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly (214,402,178,067 + 20,100,236,300 = 234,502,414,367). Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly before rounding.
